[Section] Conclusion
[source_id=40] We introduce a multilingual speech-to-text translation corpus, CoVoST, for 11 languages into English, diversified with over 11,000 speakers and over 60 accents. We also provide baseline results, including, to our knowledge, the first end-to-end many-to-one multilingual model for spoken language translation. CoVoST is free to use with a CC0 license, and the additional Tatoeba evaluation samples are also CC-licensed.
